name: Introduction to Programming
description: Foundational programming concepts, procedural logic, and problem solving.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Mathematical foundations for computer science including propositional logic and relations.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Classic data structures and algorithm analysis including asymptotic bounds and recursion.

name: Computer Organization & Architecture
description: Hardware-software interface, instruction execution cycle, and memory hierarchy.

name: Design & Analysis of Algorithms
description: Advanced algorithmic design paradigms, amortized analysis, and graph theory.

name: Operating Systems
description: Process management, memory paging, synchronization primitives, and OS kernel principles.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Relational data modeling, schema design, normalization, query optimization, and transaction recovery.

name: Computer Networks
description: Layered network architectures, packet switching, transport reliability, and routing algorithms.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Intelligent agent architectures, state-space search heuristics, game playing, and reasoning under uncertainty.

name: Machine Learning
description: Statistical learning theory, supervised/unsupervised algorithms, and predictive modeling.

name: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
description: Modern deep learning architectures, convolutional networks, attention mechanisms, and model training.

name: Full Stack Web Engineering
description: End-to-end modern web applications, client-server protocols, state management, and cloud hosting.

name: Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems
description: Distributed algorithms, fault tolerance, replication, virtualization, and container orchestration.

name: Network Security & Cryptography
description: Cryptographic primitives, asymmetric encryption, protocol security, and vulnerability assessment.

name: Compiler Construction
description: Lexical analysis, syntax-directed translation, semantic checking, and machine code optimization.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Computational linguistics, text tokenization, dense semantic embeddings, and language generation.
